input.command:
cd /home/noah/propscan && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Initial commit: PropScan v2.0.0 - High-performance license-based proprietary software detection

Features:
- 🔍 Intelligent license-based detection instead of hardcoded lists
- ⚡ High-performance concurrent processing with caching
- 📦 Support for Flatpak, Pacman, APT, and DNF package managers
- 🧠 Smart license classification (FOSS vs Proprietary vs Unknown)
- 💾 Persistent caching system with 8.6x speedup on subsequent runs
- 📊 Detailed reporting with detection reasoning
- 📋 Multiple output formats (table, JSON, simple text)
- 🧪 Comprehensive test suite (31 tests)
- 🚀 Performance benchmarking and optimization

Performance improvements:
- Concurrent package scanning with ThreadPoolExecutor
- Memory and disk caching for license information
- Batch subprocess operations with timeout protection
- Memory-efficient stream processing

🤖 Generated with opencode

Co-Authored-By: opencode <noreply@opencode.ai>
EOF
)"
input.description: Create initial commit with comprehensive message
